definition: Driver DRM resident backing and shared fields are separate from logical RGBA tile bytes and process PSS. Reply intervals are not physical scanout. A hold may draw its first stable frame once; authored durations are unchanged. Missing backend metrics are not zero usage.

stableAnimation.meaning: Visually active transform/opacity intervals, with no static/object cache rebuild or CPU tile representation conversion. Authored holds excluded. Submission time and asynchronous GPU samples are separate, not physical display cadence.

runs.drmDefinition: On Linux 6.12 amdgpu, drm-memory and drm-shared account backing buffers in each memory domain. Raw per-client fields are retained; no global exclusive physical VRAM estimate is inferred.

runs.device: ANGLE (AMD, Vulkan 1.4.305 (AMD Radeon Graphics (RADV PHOENIX) (0x00001900)), radv)
